win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 15. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER
wilds.behavior:
This game has multipliers in the form of Green Chilies. When these land together with a winning combination they reveal a value that is applied to the Global Multiplier. The Chilies add their values to the total. Multipliers are revealed and applied left to right, top to bottom.

 All wins in the current round are then multiplied by the Global Multiplier value! The Global Multiplier resets to 1x between each round.

 Green Chilies can have the following multiplier values:

 One Chili: 1x, 2x, 5x

 Two Chilies: 10x, 15x, 20x

 Three Chilies: 25x, 50x, 100x

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all paying symbols in the paytable.

 The FS symbol does not appear during Free Spins.
